title: Memory Architecture and Variables
aliases: variables A B C D X Y
summary: Seven user variables (A–D, X, Y, M), plus automatic Ans and the statistical buffer.

body.text: Standard variables A, B, C, D, X, Y store temporaries. There is no STO key: store with SHIFT RCL (STO) then the letter key (A–D, X, Y, M). Recall with RCL then the letter, or type ALPHA + letter inside an expression.
M+ adds the display to M; SHIFT M+ (M−) subtracts. Useful for running totals without overwriting A–D.
Ans holds the last evaluated result automatically. Start the next expression with an operator to chain.

body.label: Statistics modes
body.text: Independent memory behaviour can differ in SD/REG; prefer dedicated STAT recalls while analyzing datasets.
